Label: What changed?
Tip: New customer part: swap the inserted part for a revised file. Describe it: the agent makes the change, then rebuilds. I'll make it: the agent records the design, you change it, it rebuilds. Already made: you changed it but haven't saved since. Continue: pick up the last Smart Rebuild of this design from its journal.

Label: Revised customer part
Tip: For 'New customer part': the new version of the inserted part (SLDPRT, STEP, IGES, Parasolid...).

Label: The change / notes
Tip: For 'Describe the change': what to change, e.g. 'Make the cavity 2 mm deeper and move the gate to the other end'. Otherwise anything the agent should know: what changed in the new part, what must stay, what can move.

Label: Work on a copy (Save As first - the original stays as it is)
Name of the copy
Tip: Leave empty for '<file name> - rebuilt'. Saved in the same folder as the original.

Label: Big decisions
Tip: Ask on big ones: decides routine repairs, asks before anything that changes function, cost or other parts. Ask about all: asks before every judgement call. Decide everything: makes the engineering calls itself and reports them.

Label: References (optional)
Tip: Drawings, images, PDFs or models that show what the result should be.
